exposure: Single dose of live attenuated OPV and BCG vaccines within 48 hours of birth
outcome: Human cathelicidin LL37 excretion in stool
Total and anti-polio specific IgA levels in stool
finding: Infants vaccinated with OPV and BCG within 48 hours of birth had higher stool human cathelicidin LL37 levels at 6 weeks of age, and exclusive breastfeeding enhanced vaccine-induced IgA responses.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a covariate in analysis, but not specified
